headline: EU Sanctions 12 Russian Refineries and St. Petersburg Oil Terminal
summary: The European Union has sanctioned 12 major Russian refineries and the St. Petersburg Oil Terminal in response to military actions targeting civilian infrastructure in Ukraine.
why: Sanctions on Russian energy infrastructure target Moscow's export revenues and can disrupt refined product flows across international markets.

impacts.name: Russia
impacts.why: Targeted sanctions restrict the operational and export capabilities of major Russian energy facilities.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Restrictions on key refining assets raise potential compliance hurdles and affect the supply of refined petroleum products from Russia.
